newsitem.title: USA: Film crews seen boosting South Florida economy.
newsitem.headline: Film crews seen boosting South Florida economy.

text.p: Film companies and other entertainment production concerns last year spent about $200 million in Dade County, Florida, Metro Dade County Mayor Alex Penelas said on Tuesday,

At an entertainment industry conference sponsored by the Variety trade newspaper, Penelas said more than 5,000 permits were issued in 1996 for the use of public properties in Dade County by fashion photographers, television crews and makers of television commercials.

Penelas said the $200 million in direct spending translated into a $715 million lift to the Dade County economy and signaled the growing importance of entertainment-related businesses to South Florida.
